meta.coordinates: [x, z] on the ground plane. +X = east, +Z = south, north = -Z (Godot convention). Heights are meters above local ground.

areas.name: Backpack Hollow
areas.role: Wake-up pocket. Movement and camera tutorial.
areas.story: The flattened grass where Amodu was sitting when the potion hit. His body-print is the clearing.

areas.name: Blade Forest
areas.role: Densest walkable grass. First scale reveal.
areas.story: Narrow carved paths, dandelion towers, the first ant trail.

areas.name: Dewdrop Garden
areas.role: Wonder beat. Beauty shot of the level.
areas.story: Deep shade in front of the Big Oak keeps the dew all morning. Clover canopy, a lost marble, a dew-strung orb web.

areas.name: Capstone Shelter
areas.role: Meet Opigo and Opumie. First sign of civilization.
areas.story: An ant watch post under a bottle cap propped on three pebbles, overlooking the Bare Patch.

areas.name: Bare Patch
areas.role: Pill bug tutorial fight. Colony Gate.
areas.story: Dead grass where a flower pot stood all last summer; its ring is still pressed into the soil. The dry soil cracked, and the ants built their front door in the biggest crack.

areas.name: Hose Run
areas.story: The hose coupling leaks a fine jet; the mist makes a permanent morning rainbow. The ants run a water station here.

areas.name: Popsicle Bridge
areas.role: The only dry crossing into the south. Chapter 2 termite fight.
areas.story: Runoff filled the wheel rut the mower left last week. A dropped popsicle stick spans its narrowest point.

areas.name: Oak Rootlands
areas.story: Beyond the Great Root: acorns like boulders, fallen oak leaves that crunch and give you away.

areas.name: Spider's Edge
areas.story: The damp corner where the root dives under the garden edging. A silk-lined burrow, trip lines across the only entrance.

boundaries.note: 8 cm concrete step up to the patio. Sheer, hot at noon. The house rises beyond it.
40 cm garden stepping stones (144 m slabs), gaps choked with tussock.
Garden bed edging. Sunflowers tower behind it.
The Big Oak's trunk is the wall between z -100 and +100; leaf-litter drifts to either side.

barriers.note: Uncut tussock between the Great Root and the puddle. Impassable.
Closes the gap between the puddle and the stepping stones.

water.name: The Rut
water.note: Mower wheel rut flooded by hose runoff. Falling in is defeat (surface tension). Neck at x=140 is 36 m wide.

paths.label: Chapter 1 route: wake to Colony Gate
Garden Patrol: Patrol Gate to Spider's Edge
Root tunnel (opened from the south side)

landmarks.name: Amodu's backpack
landmarks.real: 42 x 30 x 15 cm, upright and slumped
landmarks.note: Tallest thing in the level. Zipper on the south face is a climb route. Player compass.

landmarks.name: Seed-head dandelion
landmarks.real: 21 cm, gone to seed; parachutes drift over the forest

landmarks.name: Lost marble
landmarks.note: Refracts the clover canopy. Lore item.

landmarks.name: Oak Root Hall (quest hub)
landmarks.note: Entrance between two root buttresses at the trunk base. Sealed until after the colony.

landmarks.name: Capstone (bottle cap roof)
landmarks.real: 30 mm cap on three 1 cm pebbles

landmarks.name: Lookout blade
landmarks.note: Thread ladder to a lookout at 25 m.

landmarks.name: Colony Gate
landmarks.real: 4 cm hair tie as arch over the crack

landmarks.name: Patrol Gate
landmarks.note: Colony side exit under a pebble.

landmarks.name: Leaking coupling / Water Station
landmarks.note: Jet sprays up and west; mist radius ~45 m with rainbow.

landmarks.name: Popsicle stick
landmarks.real: 11.4 cm stick, faded printed joke on top

landmarks.name: Termite forward camp
landmarks.note: Mud tubes. Only evidence in Ch 1, occupied in Ch 2.

skyline.name: Big Oak
skyline.real: 60 cm trunk, first branches at 3 m
skyline.note: Canopy ceiling from ~1.1 km up to 5.4 km, radius ~1.4 km. Covers the whole level; open sky only toward the east.

skyline.name: House
skyline.note: Windows are 430 m tall. Lights come on at dusk.

skyline.name: Sunflower row
skyline.note: Heads are 108 m dishes. Zone 2 teaser.

skyline.name: Compost pile
skyline.note: Steam column ~1.5 km, visible over the garden.
